name: How long does appliance hookup coordination typically add to a kitchen renovation timeline?

mainEntity.name: How long does appliance hookup coordination typically add to a kitchen renovation timeline?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time added for appliance hookup coordination is usually integrated into the overall kitchen renovation timeline. The actual hookup work itself is often completed within a few days once the appliances arrive and the necessary utility rough-ins are complete. However, planning and scheduling the specific trades, especially for new gas or electrical lines, can extend the preliminary phase. By coordinating this early, we aim to minimize any direct delays, ensuring a smooth transition from rough-in to final appliance installation. Typically, it adds minimal direct time if planned well.
acceptedAnswer.description: Integrated into the renovation timeline, actual hookups take a few days. Early planning minimizes delays, especially for new utility lines.
